events.text: Standing rule for group bookings at Bramble Hollow: for any group of twenty or more guests, we collect a thirty percent deposit and get Priya Nair's sign-off before the booking is confirmed. Groups under twenty guests need neither.
Meadow Field has 40 pitches and is free on all October weekends this year, so we can take large groups there.
Hollow Log Supply quoted £45 per bulk firewood pack, delivered on Tuesdays to the campsite yard.
Standing arrangement: each month we order bulk firewood packs from Hollow Log Supply at their list price, delivered to the campsite yard.

Ridgefield Scouts would like the weekend of Saturday 26 to Sunday 27 September, 18 people, Meadow Field if possible.
Booked the Ridgefield Scouts for the weekend of 26–27 September, 18 guests on Meadow Field. They are under twenty so no deposit or sign-off was needed.
Confirmation of our quote: bulk firewood packs at £45 each, Tuesday deliveries to Bramble Hollow.
Ordered six bulk firewood packs from Hollow Log Supply for the September delivery at £45 each, per the standing arrangement.
Rowan Build Ltd will start the shower block refurbishment on Monday 5 October; it runs two weeks and the east facilities will be closed during the work.
The Harlow family wants a birthday party group on Saturday 17 October, 30 guests on Meadow Field.

Fairway Catering quotes £9 per head for a group supper at Bramble Hollow, served in the barn.
Booked the bat-activity talk with the county wildlife officer for Saturday 3 October in the barn, open to all campers, no charge.
Ordered four bulk firewood packs from Hollow Log Supply for the October delivery at £45 each, per the standing arrangement.

Writing our group booking practice in one place so there is no confusion: if a group is twenty or more people, we take a deposit of thirty percent and Priya Nair signs off before we mark the booking confirmed. Smaller groups are simply booked. This is how we have been doing it and how it stays.
Fairway Catering sent their autumn price list: barn breakfasts are now £6 a head and suppers for groups of thirty or more are £11 a head.
For our weekend of 26–27 September, could the campsite arrange a group supper on the Saturday evening in the barn? We will be 18 people.
Happy to do the scouts' supper on Saturday 26 September at our quoted £9 a head for your group size; just confirm the final headcount.
Reminder to order gravel for the Meadow Field access track before the October half-term.
